# Tips GitHub's activity record lists that origin no longer serves, each one reviewed by hand
# (.github/scripts/fork-secret-scan.sh, "sweep, gone tips"). A tip GitHub has deleted (its API has
# no commit of that id) that a successful secret-scan job had as its head commit needs no line: the
# sweep finds that run and only warns. The daily secret sweep fails on any other such tip not named
# here. It reads this file from the default branch only, so a line counts once its pull request is
# merged.
#
# One line per tip: <full commit id> <why it is known gone: how it was checked, and when>.
# Exact commit ids only. Add a line only after looking for the commit on GitHub (its commit page,
# or `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/<id>`): when GitHub still shows it, read it for a key
# first and rotate any key found. A line that is not of this form fails the sweep.
# A deleted tip no scan read was never scanned: its line records that its content is no longer
# served, not that it was clean.
# Remove a line when the sweep warns that origin serves the tip again (it is then scanned).
